rows.notes: The cited document is explicitly a review (titled 'Review' in Agronomy 2023) that synthesises published work on drones and sensors for plant disease detection. It reports no original data, experiment, survey or model runs of its own ('Data Availability Statement: Not applicable'). All results described (e.g. rice sheath blight NDVI, potato late blight, HLB, myrtle rust, Ir-UNet yellow rust) are cited from other studies. Consequently Q1 is 'no' and all other questions are 'no'. Note also that the content concerns disease detection/monitoring rather than pest control per se; the review asserts but does not demonstrate that detection leads to control.

notes: Document text appears complete (pages 1-26 including references). Study is a narrative review with no primary data; some text is duplicated due to PDF layout artefacts but this does not affect the rating.
